content:
Decisions from the user on 2026-10-01.

19. The German AI side uses COLING 2025 GenAI Detection Task 1 plus the German conversations in WildChat. Fresh generation waits until a measurement shows a gap.
20. Gender forms stay out of scope. de_binnen_i drops, and no test covers gender forms.
21. Anglicisms follow humanizer-de. Technical terms, titles, and established loanwords pass.
22. German text allows the Ergänzungsstrich, a word ending in a hyphen before und, oder, or bis.
23. Every German rule passes the same 0.85 precision bar on the German corpus. A rule at or above the bar blocks hard. A rule below it observes.
24. All 80 rules from the catalog land in this work, not in stages. Each one still blocks only after its measurement clears 0.85.
